Le point d'étoile se fait en relevant ci: The star stitch is made by pulling up five loops in a row onto the hook, then closing them all together. The chain that follows is called the eye of the star: that eye is where you insert the hook for the next loop. One row of stars, one row of mesh, alternating. Nothing more, and the result is spectacular.

What makes the whole look is always working the sc into the front loop of the dc from the previous row, and the dc into the back loop of the sc.
